purpose: Evaluate one nearest-real-source retry without per-ID FitShift state; no production decision
selection: Exactly the retained ten physically-near initial single-mirror raw-det failures, four top-side and six bottom-corner
source: Existing initial 5000 real soil coordinates and native IDs; no images or synthetic support
retry: For each original mirror, choose exactly one nearest real source from its existing support and centre the retry there. No second candidate or parameter search.
ties: Record exact binary64 squared-distance tie count; the retained native ledger order chooses the first. Current sorted CPU/GPU neighbour order and float arithmetic are not claimed to choose the same ID in ties.
evaluation: Original own-face mirror stays the evaluation point. Reuse unchanged top-shift pure fit to return fitted-intercept and dynamic nearest-anchor values with q=-physical gradient.
comparison: Retained four-point top tangential-minus-dp and six-point existing-SPR halfspace-projection CSVs; compare raw determinant, condition, support and shift without refitting those alternatives
matrix: Same retained double-only 2D Cubic W/Fac, dp=.04, h=.048, V=dp^2 at initial J=1, original unscaled a_corr2
eligibility: Original physical wall distance to real soil<=2h=.096m, unchanged. Retry source must lie strictly within the original mirror support.
det_gate: Original abs(raw determinant)>=1e-3, unchanged; original failed/singular matrices are never inverted. Only valid rank3 retry fits receive reproduction checks.
reproduction: Record values at original mirror and physical fitted-gradient errors; no new numerical or physical acceptance threshold
implementation_scope: The existing dynamic MLS nearest source/neardr could supply a geometric retry centre locally, potentially avoiding new per-ID GPU FitShift input. This offline check does not implement or admit it.
limitations: Binary64 static geometry only, not production float kernel constants/arithmetic or sorted accumulation. Far-wall eligibility/masking remains unresolved; nonlinear accuracy, actual NoSlip/state/stress/pressure/Ace parity and deformed-stage support remain unproved.
protected: Only new script/note/10-row CSV/check; source and old evidence unchanged, input metadata before/after, SHA0, no solver/build/Git
